title: DesignDay at Dfrost 2016
description:
The theme for this month's DesignDay is:

Transformation by Amalgation

DesignDay is a monthly event that brings together designers from multidisciplinary backgrounds to a common platform in order to interact and learn from each other.

This month DesignDay collaborates with NID and the event would be held at the NID Bangalore Campus as part of Dfrost 2016.

The agenda includes:
1. An Inspiration Design Story by a well-experienced designer to walk us through the trials and tribulations of their career in design.
2. A Skill Building Session by a mid-career designer to teach us something new using real world examples and case studies.
3. A Jam by you and fellow participants (in groups) to come up with some design suggestions based on a given topic in 1 hour.
